_why: What the old witch SELLS, as data so a server owner can put a shelf together with a datapack and /reload (the pure validator is StockSchema.java). The shelf is EMPTY on purpose: the witch only ever sold Skill Books (route books at 2,000,000 to 3,000,000 gold) and SP Books, and both items, together with the unique skills they taught, were removed at the owner's request (docs/skill_books_removed.md). The witch still BUYS goods for gold (prices.json). A line is a SLOT on the shelf: at every restock its price is rolled inside [price_min, price_max] from the world seed and the restock period, 'stock' copies are put out, and 'weight' is the percent chance the slot is on the shelf; the only kinds the code knows are the two removed book kinds, which sell nothing (the shop makes no item for them), so a line is of no use until a new kind of good is added. Keys that start with an underscore are comments.
